messages:
noah (PM): Kicking off a short thread to align on a compact onboarding playbook for the next DP/beta cohort. Aim: 8-12 partners, 4-week engagement, minimal friction. Need recruit signals, intake checklist, light-weight observability ask, and clear exit/launch criteria. Thoughts?
tara (Eng): For signals — look for teams with stable keys and >=500 tokens/day + at least 2 devs hitting the system (shows iterativeness). Also prioritize repeated long-prefix reuse (we get biggest perf wins there).
chen (Sales): Add commercial signal: at least one stakeholder willing to sign a month-long PO or commit to a follow-on pilot if we land key wins. That makes prioritization easier.
amelia (Design): Feed cadence: weekly 5-question micro-survey (takes <3 mins) + one end-of-run 20-min interview. Also ask partners to share 1 workflow screenshot/video showing critical latency pain.
noah (PM): Intake checklist proposal (minimal): 1) short use-case summary (3 bullets), 2) representative sample prompts (5 max), 3) perf goal (p50/p95), 4) data class (PII? yes/no), 5) desired routing (hosted/dedicated/private). Keep as single page form.
tara (Eng): Observability ask: optional light trace + one failing prompt example. Provide a tiny upload template (text blob) so they don't need to instrument anything heavier. Example snippet we can parse: `PROMPT: <text>
EXPECTED: <text>
OBSERVED_LATENCY_MS: 1234
MODEL: redwood-llama-7b`
chen (Sales): Incentive model: $1.5k credit + prioritized support + a joint case study option. If partner prefers, swap credits for dev-hours (2 x 2h) from our Solutions team.
amelia (Design): Success criteria (suggested): - 75% active participation (complete >=2 micro-surveys) - 2 actionable product changes surfaced - onboarding time <= 4 business days - partner-reported latency improvement or usability win.
noah (PM): Launch gate checklist (must-have to call it a win): 1) at least one regression-free performance improvement in staging, 2) partner signs off on the change, 3) docs/FAQ updated for the use-case. Optional: consent for anonymized quote.
ops-bot: Heads-up: reminder for legal intake templates and NDA staging available at /legal/templates/dp-nda-v2 (auto-post).
tara (Eng): A note on scope negotiation: offer a lightweight 'trial scope' doc that lists 3 experiments we'll run (perf tuning, batching config, cache policy). Partners pick 1-2 they care most about. Sets expectations.
chen (Sales): Recruiting channels: existing customer accounts, community newsletter, and curated outreach to platform partners. I'll draft a targeted outreach email with CTA for intake form.
amelia (Design): I'll build a 1-page invite mock + intake form UI (Google Form + optional JSON paste) by Wednesday.
noah (PM): Great. Action items: chen -> outreach copy by Tue; amelia -> invite + form Wed; tara -> trace template + trial-scope doc Wed; I'll prepare cohort timeline + KPI tracker and share by Thu. If we can get 6 confirmed partners in 10 days we open the first cohort. :rocket:
